title: Which THUMB Is On Top When You Clasp Your Hands? 🙏
description:
Clasp your hands without thinking. Now put the OTHER thumb on top. Feels wrong, right? Clasped fingers sit turn about (thumb, thumb, finger, finger...), so putting the other thumb on top moves every finger one place over, next to two new neighbours. Which way is normal? Neither: about 55% of people clasp left thumb on top, 44% right, and about 1% have no favourite (Reiss 1999, Annals of Human Biology). And it isn't simple genetics: in four twin studies, about 4 in 10 identical twin pairs clasp with different thumbs on top. Left thumb or right?
